title: Finite relation matrices descend to a common stage
statement: Finite matrix coefficients of a linear map between finite free modules over a directed ring colimit are represented at one stage.

proof.text: Use Concrete.colimit_exists_rep to represent each of the finitely many entries. IsFiltered.sup_objs_exists gives a common receiving stage. Transport representatives there using F.map; colimit.w gives their images. Matrix.toLin' constructs qi and Matrix.mulVec_single_one gives its coefficients.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_stage_finite_relation_matrix
    {I : Type u} [PartialOrder I] [Nonempty I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (F : I ⥤ CommRingCat) (n m : ℕ)
    (q : (Fin m → (colimit F : CommRingCat)) →ₗ[(colimit F : CommRingCat)]
      (Fin n → (colimit F : CommRingCat))) :
    ∃ (i : I) (qi : (Fin m → F.obj i) →ₗ[F.obj i] (Fin n → F.obj i)),
      ∀ (j : Fin n) (k : Fin m),
        (colimit.ι F i).hom (qi (Pi.single k 1) j) = q (Pi.single k 1) j
